summary.headline: Religare Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 26% YoY to INR2,358 crores, but PBT swung to a loss of INR76.7 crores as RBI declined the demerger approval.
summary.overview: Consolidated income reached INR2,358 crores against INR1,876 crores a year earlier, while total expenses of INR2,435 crores drove a PBT loss of INR76.73 crores versus a profit of INR5.73 crores. Care Health Insurance grew GWP 37% YoY on a full-premium basis and raised INR150 crores of equity, but its combined ratio stayed above 100% at 102.6% under Ind AS. RBI did not accede to the demerger application, and management said it is engaging with the regulator with no timeline. Broking profit rebounded, while RFL and Religare Housing reported lower income and losses as they rebuild.

segments.name: Care Health Insurance
segments.commentary: GWP +37% YoY to INR3,247 crores (full premium); retail new business up over 50%; retail market share 12.6% of industry and 21.6% in SAHI. Ind AS PBT INR163 crores; investment book up over INR800 crores QoQ with leverage at 4.3x.

segments.name: Religare Broking
segments.commentary: Total income INR99.5 crores (+7% YoY), brokerage 47% of revenue, interest income 30%, e-governance 16%. Client debit book +78% YoY; cash ADTO INR375 crores vs INR334 crores; AUC INR47,946 crores.

segments.name: Religare Finvest (RFL)
segments.commentary: Core SME book about INR53 crores; net worth about INR915 crores; cash over INR600 crores; CRAR 238%; NNPA about 0.8%; collection efficiency 98%. Income fell on smaller loan book and lower GNPA recoveries.

segments.name: Religare Housing Finance
segments.commentary: AUM INR247 crores (66% home loans, 34% LAP); about 15 branches in eight states; GNPA 4.4%, NNPA 3.3%; yield 14.6%; net worth about INR180 crores, CRAR above 121%.

guidance_outlook: Care targets a 100% combined ratio within two years, reiterated from last call; management declined full-year growth guidance but aims to beat the market.
Care year-end leverage expected to fall to about 3.7x after capital infusion.
Care to maintain solvency at about 1.7x; solvency was 1.58x at June 2026 against a 1.5x requirement.
RFL expects to start new lending business in roughly four months, and management ambitions a INR10,000-15,000 crore book on INR1,500-2,000 crores of capital.
Demerger timeline (previously targeted Q1 FY28) likely to slip; management gave no timeline for resolution with RBI.
capex_capacity: Care raised INR150 crores equity via rights issue in Q1 and INR200 crores subordinated debt in August 2026; of the INR600 crore earmarked, over INR376 crores infused so far.
Next Care capital raise likely via rights issue, per management.
Religare Housing to receive about INR250 crores further capital over the next few years against INR180 crores current net worth.
RFL: INR618 crores of INR1,500 crores warrant proceeds converted; INR881 crores remains due for conversion by March 2027.
Legacy written-off pool of INR350-400 crores under recovery; Q1 recoveries about INR20 crores.
demand_pricing: Care attributes growth to a 'land grab' in the market post-GST relaxation; growth driven by Tier 2/3 geographies and fresh business.
Industry health insurance grew 22.4% overall and 32% in retail; Care grew 18% above industry in retail.
Care's Q1 skews to corporate employee wellness business with upfront claims, which the company says inflates the combined ratio.
Broking: management attributes the revenue softness to market conditions and attrition; unique traded clients broadly stable.
RBI letter: no reasons attached; management says RBI did not object on capital structure grounds as stated in the letter.

qa_highlights.question: Why was the demerger rejected and is a partial demerger or stake sale of Care under consideration?
qa_highlights.answer: Arjun Lamba said the RBI letter gives no reasoning; the company is engaging with the regulator and is not pursuing other options for now. No timeline was given.

qa_highlights.question: Why is Care's CISR 102.7% when insurance service result is only about -INR3 crores?
qa_highlights.answer: Ambrish Jindal said CISR includes non-attributable expenses; an INR66 crore item after net finance result is added in CISR computation, which explains the gap.

qa_highlights.question: Why does consolidated Care show a loss when standalone Ind AS shows profit?
qa_highlights.answer: Ambrish Jindal said Care took a one-year forbearance on Ind AS 117 at consolidation, so the impact is not in consolidated accounts; this aligns from next year.

qa_highlights.question: What are the RFL/Housing growth plans and why is cash so high at RFL?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said RFL was under PCA/CAP and lacked market funding for 7-8 years, so disbursements stopped; it expects to start business in about four months, with capital of INR1,500-2,000 crores targeting INR10,000-15,000 crores book.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the written-off book can be recovered and at what pace?
qa_highlights.answer: Srinivasan Karthik said the pool is INR350-400 crores of secured legacy loans facing litigation and repossession; recoveries are expected to decline each quarter and happen over about two years.

qa_highlights.question: Is the RBI approval tied to merging the Burman-held private NBFCs?
qa_highlights.answer: Pratul Gupta said RBI's observation does not relate to merging the two sets of NBFCs; Arjun Lamba said the company is not aware of any such condition in the letter.

risks_watch: Demerger: RBI has not acceded to the application with no reasons given and no timeline; management says the Q1 FY28 target will likely slip and that RBI approval is a precondition for any value-unlocking route.

Care solvency: 1.58x at June 2026 against a 1.5x requirement; management targets 1.7x, with the INR200 crore sub-debt raised in August 2026 and any further raise likely via rights issue. Year-end leverage guided to about 3.7x from 4.3x.

Care combined ratio: 102.6% under Ind AS, above 100%; target of 100% within two years. Consolidated accounts show a loss because of a one-year Ind AS 117 forbearance, which management says ends from next year.

Financial services ramp-up: RFL and Religare Housing have no new disbursements yet; RFL expects to start business in about four months and holds about INR600 crores of cash against a core book of about INR53 crores. Track launch timing and the INR10,000-15,000 crore book ambition.
Legacy recoveries: INR350-400 crore written-off pool with Q1 recoveries about INR20 crores; management expects recoveries to decline each quarter over about two years. Watch the quarterly run-rate.
Broking: revenue flat QoQ and the business is in a repair phase with no clear model for one to two quarters; competitive positioning unresolved.

summary.management_tone: Confident on Care's growth and capital position, but guarded on the demerger, where the RBI letter gives no reasons and management declined to give any timeline. Management was also evasive on full-year growth guidance and on the broking business model, saying the direction would be clear in one or two quarters.
